market_summary: London session displays persistent risk-off themes. XAUUSD and BTCUSD continue their clear macro and structural downtrends below their respective session VWAP, EMA50, and Value Area Lows with bearish CVD confirmation, offering clean short continuation setups. Meanwhile, EURUSD and US100 are trapped in range-bound Value Area rotations around flat VWAP clusters, dictating a HOLD stance until breakout volume emerges.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (3960.79) and POC (3978.28), confirming heavy value area displacement to the downside. CVD is BEARISH (-4.32) with a negative slope (-0.9), aligning with prevailing selling pressure. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price trades well below both VWAP (3969.59) and EMA50 (3964.15). Signal candle closed weak at 3943.55 and the forming bar is struggling right at the EMA20 baseline (3949.97), hovering near the lower half of the ATR channel. Volume is standard (RVOL 1.082) without high-volume buying, maintaining downside momentum toward Session Low (3924.30). GEX is null.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping VWAP and EMA50

lucid_plan.sizing: fixed target 1.3 reaches $752 net with 6 GC (risk $1140)

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10786 to VAH 1.10998) and below POC (1.10943), suggesting mean-reverting chop. CVD is NEUTRAL (+2,166) with a declining slope (-1,713.4). Session is LONDON_SESSION. While signal candle printed RVOL > 2.0 (2.04), it rejected S/R (1.11007) and upper ATR band, falling back into the VWAP (1.10867) and EMA50 (1.10898) cluster. Lack of clean acceptance above VAH or directional CVD divergence warrants patience.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral hovering near flat VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 28086.57 to VAH 28185.57) and above POC (28121.92). CVD is BEARISH (-2.87) with a flat slope (0.06), showing divergence against the recent bounce. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is sandwiched tightly between VWAP (28133.11) and EMA50 (28160.87), sitting directly mid-channel. Per US100 caveat, RVOL is 1.173 with no yellow spike, and price is caught between Session High (28265.71) and S/R supports (28100.36), making a directional bet low-probability.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral oscillating around VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (73295.04) and POC (73518.45). CVD is BEARISH (-0.05) confirming broader short-side order flow. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Trend is strongly bearish, remaining well below VWAP (73532.02) and EMA50 (73490.93). Signal bar formed an attempted relief bounce that rejected directly beneath Prev Low (73097.30), while the forming bar resumed downward pressure right at the lower ATR band (72873.64). Volume on the bounce was sub-threshold (RVOL 1.591, no yellow spike), pointing to a continuation flush toward Session Low (72639.70).
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish sustained below descending VWAP and EMA50
